# Specs generated from the Lean model

Each folder is a requirement spec with one `requirements.md`, generated from the rules in one Lean module. The acceptance criteria are in EARS notation, and the folders follow the layout Kiro reads. The rule's docstring holds the user story and the acceptance criteria; the build computes each criterion's status from the theorems and examples tagged `@[checks]` with its ID. To change a requirement, edit the docstring and rebuild.

51 acceptance criteria: 37 proven, 7 example only, 6 open, 1 not checked.

| Spec | Requirement | User story | Criteria | Proven | Example only | Open | Not checked |

| [Order items and orders](one-order-order-items-and-orders/requirements.md) | ONE-002 | As a revenue accountant, I want each order item's status worked out from its services, so that I know which items still hold value. | 4 | 3 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| [Order items and orders](one-order-order-items-and-orders/requirements.md) | ONE-003 | As an airline, I want an order's status worked out from its items and services, so that an order is closed only when nothing in it holds value. | 4 | 3 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| [Payment status and paid items](one-order-payment-status-and-paid-items/requirements.md) | ONE-301 | As an airline, I want a payment made with several methods to succeed only when every method succeeds, so that I never treat an order item as paid when part of its money will not arrive. | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| [Payment status and paid items](one-order-payment-status-and-paid-items/requirements.md) | ONE-302 | As an airline, I want an order item counted as paid only when a payment for it has succeeded, so that I release nothing on money I may not collect. | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| [Payment status and paid items](one-order-payment-status-and-paid-items/requirements.md) | ONE-303 | As an airline, I want the outcome of each payment method's transaction recorded as it arrives, so that a payment's status follows what I know about its funds. | 3 | 2 | 0 | 1 | 0 |
| [Accepting a payment](one-order-accepting-a-payment/requirements.md) | ONE-304 | As an airline, I want each payment checked against the items it pays for, so that items are paid in full and on time, and each method is charged its amount plus its surcharge. | 6 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| [Applying a payment outcome](one-order-applying-a-payment-outcome/requirements.md) | ONE-305 | As an airline, I want a successful payment to release the order items it paid for, so that their services can be delivered and are no longer at risk of removal. | 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

| [Orders](offer-order-orders/requirements.md) | OO-002 | As an operations agent, I want a service's delivery state to change only along the allowed transitions, so that a delivered service is never cancelled and a service is never refunded before it is cancelled. | 5 | 1 | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| [Payments and refunds](offer-order-payments-and-refunds/requirements.md) | OO-003 | As a customer service agent, I want each refund checked against the payment it is made against, so that a customer is never refunded more than they paid. | 2 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 |

## Acceptance criteria

| ID | Criterion | Status | Checked by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ONE-001.1 | WHEN an offer is accepted THE SYSTEM SHALL create exactly one order item for each offer item. | proven | proven theorem `accept_item_per_offer_item`; example `acceptFamilyOffer` |
| ONE-001.2 | WHEN an order item is created THE SYSTEM SHALL give it one service for each passenger and flight segment of its offer item. | proven | proven theorem `accept_services_per_passenger_segment`; example `acceptFamilyOffer` |
| ONE-001.3 | WHEN an order is created THE SYSTEM SHALL give its order items distinct references. | proven | proven theorem `accept_item_ids_unique`; example `acceptFamilyOffer` |
| ONE-001.4 | WHEN an order is created THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it opened. | proven | proven theorem `accept_order_opened`; example `acceptFamilyOffer` |
| ONE-001.5 | IF a customer accepts an offer at or after its expiry instant THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it as expired. | proven | proven theorem `accept_rejects_expired`; example `acceptFamilyAtExpiry` |
| ONE-002.1 | WHILE at least one service of an order item holds value THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the item active. | proven | proven theorem `item_active_iff`; example `paidItem` |
| ONE-002.2 | WHEN every service of an order item is cancelled or transferred and none holds value THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the item cancelled. | proven | proven theorem `item_cancelled_iff`; example `cancelledItem` |
| ONE-002.3 | WHEN at least one service of an order item is delivered and every other service is delivered or removed THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the item closed. | proven | proven theorem `item_closed_iff`; example `closedItem` |
| ONE-002.4 | THE SYSTEM SHALL give each order item exactly one status. | open | proven theorem `active_not_cancelled`; proven theorem `active_not_closed`; open theorem `item_has_one_status`; counterexample `deliveredThenTransferred`; counterexample `suspendedService` |
| ONE-003.1 | WHILE at least one service of an order holds value THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the order opened. | proven | proven theorem `order_opened_iff`; example `acceptFamilyOffer` |
| ONE-003.2 | WHEN every item of an order is closed or cancelled and every service is delivered or removed THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the order closed. | proven | proven theorem `order_closed_iff`; example `deliveredOrder` |
| ONE-003.3 | THE SYSTEM SHALL never mark an order both opened and closed. | proven | proven theorem `opened_closed_exclusive` |
| ONE-003.4 | THE SYSTEM SHALL give every order that has a service either the status opened or the status closed. | open | open theorem `order_opened_or_closed`; counterexample `expiredService` |
| ONE-301.1 | IF the transaction of any payment method in a payment fails THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the whole payment FAILED. | proven | proven theorem `status_failed_iff`; example `declinedCardForBag`; example `statusFromMethods` |
| ONE-301.2 | WHEN the transactions of every payment method in a payment succeed THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the payment SUCCESSFUL. | proven | proven theorem `status_successful_iff`; example `statusFromMethods` |
| ONE-301.3 | WHILE no payment method's transaction in a payment has failed and at least one is still pending THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the payment PENDING. | proven | proven theorem `status_pending_iff`; example `statusFromMethods` |
| ONE-302.1 | WHEN a SUCCESSFUL payment covers an order item THE SYSTEM SHALL count the item paid. | proven | proven theorem `isPaid_iff`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined` |
| ONE-302.2 | IF every payment covering an order item is PENDING or FAILED THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL not count the item paid. | proven | proven theorem `isPaid_iff`; example `pendingRedirect`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined` |
| ONE-302.3 | IF the transaction of any payment method in a payment fails THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL count none of the order items it covers as paid by that payment and shall leave their services unchanged. | proven | proven theorem `failed_method_pays_nothing`; example `declinedCardForBag` |
| ONE-303.1 | WHEN the airline reports a SUCCESSFUL or FAILED outcome for a payment method's transaction that is still PENDING THE SYSTEM SHALL record the outcome. | proven | proven theorem `recordOutcome_pending`; example `redirectCompletes` |
| ONE-303.2 | WHEN the airline reports the outcome of one payment method's transaction THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the transactions of the payment's other methods unchanged. | proven | proven theorem `recordOutcome_other_methods`; example `redirectCompletes` |
| ONE-303.3 | THE SYSTEM SHALL never change the status of a payment that is SUCCESSFUL or FAILED. | open | open theorem `recordOutcome_settled_final`; counterexample `chargeback`; counterexample `lateRedirectCapture` |
| ONE-304.1 | WHEN the airline accepts a payment THE SYSTEM SHALL charge each payment method its requested amount plus its surcharge. | proven | proven theorem `acceptPayment_charges`; example `splitPaymentCharges` |
| ONE-304.2 | IF the requested amounts of a payment do not add up to the price of the order items it covers THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment. | proven | proven theorem `acceptPayment_requested_eq_price`; example `surchargeCountedAsPrice` |
| ONE-304.3 | WHEN the airline accepts a payment THE SYSTEM SHALL charge in total the price of the order items it covers plus the surcharges of its payment methods. | proven | proven theorem `acceptPayment_total`; example `splitPaymentCharges` |
| ONE-304.4 | IF a payment is made at or after the payment time limit of an order item it covers THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment. | proven | proven theorem `acceptPayment_rejects_after_time_limit`; example `paymentAfterTimeLimit` |
| ONE-304.5 | IF a payment uses the commitment method with an amount other than zero THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment. | proven | proven theorem `acceptPayment_commitment_zero`; example `commitmentForFreeSeat` |
| ONE-304.6 | IF a payment uses the commitment method for order items with an amount to pay THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the payment. | proven | proven theorem `acceptPayment_commitment_zero`; example `commitmentBesideCard`; example `commitmentForFreeSeat` |
| ONE-305.1 | WHEN a payment is SUCCESSFUL THE SYSTEM SHALL move every CONFIRMED service of the order items it covers to READY TO PROCEED. | proven | proven theorem `applyOutcome_ready`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined` |
| ONE-305.2 | WHEN a payment is SUCCESSFUL THE SYSTEM SHALL remove the payment time limits of the order items it covers. | proven | proven theorem `applyOutcome_no_time_limit`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined` |
| ONE-305.3 | IF a payment is FAILED THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the services and payment time limits of the order items it covers unchanged. | proven | proven theorem `applyOutcome_unsuccessful`; example `declinedCardForBag`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined` |
| ONE-305.4 | WHILE a payment is PENDING THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the services and payment time limits of the order items it covers unchanged. | proven | proven theorem `applyOutcome_unsuccessful`; example `pendingRedirect` |
| ONE-305.5 | THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the order items a payment does not cover unchanged. | proven | proven theorem `applyOutcome_uncovered`; example `twoPaymentsOneDeclined` |
| ONE-306.1 | WHEN an order item's payment time limit has passed and no SUCCESSFUL payment covers it THE SYSTEM SHALL remove the item. | proven | proven theorem `expireUnpaid_removes`; example `lateRedirectCapture`; example `unpaidAtTimeLimit` |
| ONE-306.2 | WHEN an order item is removed at its payment time limit THE SYSTEM SHALL mark FAILED every PENDING payment that covers it. | proven | proven theorem `expireUnpaid_fails_pending`; example `lateRedirectCapture`; example `unpaidAtTimeLimit` |
| ONE-306.3 | IF a SUCCESSFUL payment covers an order item THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL not remove the item at a payment time limit. | proven | proven theorem `expireUnpaid_keeps_paid`; example `unpaidAtTimeLimit` |
| ONE-306.4 | WHILE an order item's payment time limit has not passed THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the item unchanged. | proven | proven theorem `expireUnpaid_keeps_before_limit`; example `unpaidAtTimeLimit` |
| ONE-306.5 | THE SYSTEM SHALL not keep an unpaid order item in the order indefinitely. | open | open theorem `unpaid_item_removed_eventually`; counterexample `noTimeLimit` |
| ONE-306.6 | WHEN an order item is removed at its payment time limit THE SYSTEM SHALL leave none of its services holding value. | open | open theorem `removed_item_holds_no_value`; counterexample `removalStatuses` |
| OO-001.1 | IF a customer accepts an offer at or after its expiry instant THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it as expired. | proven | proven theorem `accept_rejects_expired`; example `acceptAtExpiry` |
| OO-001.2 | IF a customer accepts an unexpired offer that has no items THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it as empty. | example only | example `acceptEmptyOffer` |
| OO-001.3 | IF a customer accepts an unexpired offer with an item priced in a currency other than the offer's THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it for mixed currencies. | example only | example `acceptMixedCurrency` |
| OO-001.4 | WHEN a customer accepts an unexpired offer with at least one item and every item priced in the offer's currency THE SYSTEM SHALL create an order. | example only | example `acceptBeforeExpiry` |
| OO-001.5 | WHEN an order is created from an offer THE SYSTEM SHALL price the order at the sum of the offer's item prices. | proven | proven theorem `accept_price_eq_sum`; example `acceptBeforeExpiry` |
| OO-002.1 | WHEN a ready service is delivered THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it delivered. | example only | example `deliveryWalk`; example `transitionTable` |
| OO-002.2 | WHEN a ready service is cancelled THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it cancelled. | example only | example `transitionTable` |
| OO-002.3 | WHEN a cancelled service is refunded THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it refunded. | example only | example `transitionTable` |
| OO-002.4 | IF a delivered service is cancelled THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse the event. | proven | proven theorem `delivered_not_cancellable`; example `deliveryWalk`; example `transitionTable` |
| OO-002.5 | IF any other event is applied to a service THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse the event. | example only | example `transitionTable` |
| OO-003.1 | WHEN a refund is requested against a payment THE SYSTEM SHALL accept it only if it names that payment and its amount does not exceed the payment's amount. | not checked | nothing in the build checks this yet |
| OO-003.2 | THE SYSTEM SHALL not refund more against an order than was paid for it. | open | open theorem `refunds_le_payments`; counterexample `doubleRefund` |

The same rows are in [`ears-criteria.csv`](https://samdengler.github.io/airline-order-verified/ears-criteria.csv), and one row per rule is in [`ears.csv`](https://samdengler.github.io/airline-order-verified/ears.csv).
